title: Vertigo Triple Cyclone
description:
Vertigo Triple Cyclone
The Cyclone from vertigo is a good quality lighter and is a great option when paired with a vapcap.
It has 3 jets, is adjustable via the adjustment wheel on the bottom and is translucent so you can see how much butane you have left.
Due to shipping laws all lighters are shipped empty.
Included
1 x Vertigo Triple Cyclone (random colour)(empty for shipping)
1 x Sleeve
